title: Umbral Spire - The Black Ascent
_note: CLIMAX mood sibling - the pure dread/ascent loop for the climb itself: Cor's null-lanterns leaking anti-light, the fight against the dark before the win. All tension, no release; the darkest energy in the score. gba era (8 voices, chords allowed). 140 BPM, 4/4, relentless A minor (NO resolution). 32-bar loop, deliberately unresolved. Vesper motif driven in HARD MINOR, urgent and overshooting (E3->A3->B3 ... settle DENIED) - it never resolves, holding tension until the major payoff of Option A/C. lead=pulse25 driving the minor motif hard, anxious and climbing. counter-lead=a second darting line raising tension. harmony=tense reverbed pad + an anti-light shimmer (detuned high voice for the leaking null-lanterns). bass=pounding driving bass, no rest. drums=full relentless, fills ratcheting tension. Last bar = E(V) drives straight back to bar 1's A, no release.
